Help & Guide

How TraceCard AI works.

Getting started

1. Upload a PDF

Choose a PDF lecture file. Text is extracted page by page, with OCR fallback.

2. Generate flashcards

Select the number of sets and cards, then generate multiple-choice questions.

3. Validate each set

Edit, approve, or reject flashcards before reviewing them.

4. Review & track

Rate recall as Difficult (1 day), Partially Remembered (3 days), or Remembered (7 days).

Source viewing requires the original PDF to be uploaded in the current session. AI generation requires your site's existing /api/gemini backend.
